subject: delta(client): WF restrict the retained CREATE reader to the signed CREATEs of one delivery
note: openRetainedCreateJournal now takes exactly { deliveryId } and refuses any other member, including laneKey, with reader_input_invalid before reading the journal. It returns { deliveryId, records } holding only the retained signed CREATE_STORAGE_PROGRAM transactions whose signed delivery fields name that delivery, whatever their journal key. Other recorder members are unchanged. No core file changes, so the hold pins are unchanged.
